abstract: PURPOSE: To evaluate the factors including the imaging findings and clinical and laboratory data that were useful for diagnosing mature cystic teratomas with malignant transformation. MATERIALS AND METHODS: In 11 patients, we analyzed the imaging findings by the CT and MR focused on the soft tissue components for the following characteristics: size; the angle between the soft tissue components and the inner wall of the cyst (acute or obtuse); the configuration of the inner border (regular or irregular); and enhancement as well as tumor size. Clinical and laboratory data such as age, serum SCC, CA-125, CA 19-9, and AFP, were also determined. RESULTS: In the analysis of the imaging findings, nine (82%) of all tumors had soft tissue components and eight (89%) of nine soft-tissue-containing tumors showed an obtuse angle between the soft tissue components and the inner wall of the cyst as well as enhancement. In nine (82%) of the study patients it was shown that the largest diameter of the tumor was larger than 9.9 cm and the patients were older than 45 years. In the results of the laboratory data, six (67%) of performed nine patients had a CA-125 elevation greater than 35 U/ml and three (75%) of performed four patients had a CA 19-9 elevation greater than 37 U/ml. CONCLUSION: We suggest that preoperative diagnosis may be improved and available in cases of synthesized imaging findings with clinical and laboratory data.
abstract_ja: 目的：悪性転化を伴う成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の診断に有用な画像所見、臨床・検査データを評価すること。対象と方法：11例において、CTおよびMRIの軟部組織成分に着目し、大きさ、軟部組織成分と嚢胞内壁のなす角度(鋭角または鈍角)、内縁の形状(整または不整)、増強効果、腫瘍径を解析した。年齢、血清SCC、CA-125、CA 19-9、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)などの臨床・検査データも検討した。結果：画像所見では、腫瘍の9例(82%)が軟部組織成分を有し、軟部組織を含む腫瘍9例中8例(89%)が軟部組織と嚢胞内壁の間に鈍角を示し、かつ増強効果を示した。対象患者の9例(82%)では最大径が9.9cmを超え、年齢は45歳を超えていた。検査データでは、CA-125検査を行った9例中6例(67%)で35U/mlを超える上昇が、CA 19-9検査を行った4例中3例(75%)で37U/mlを超える上昇が見られた。結論：臨床・検査データと統合した画像所見を組み合わせることで、術前診断が改善され、利用可能となる可能性がある。
